meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 装上后,当你问起某条 senpi 提示(启动提示、工作提示或 Tip: 行)时,Claude 会先查在线提示列表,再读实际代码,给出这条提示的深入解释,并用你提问时所用的语言回答,附上它读过的文件路径。
howto.when: 当你问起某条提示、某个被提示的功能做什么,或你能看到哪些提示时触发。它还会先读你的 senpi 设置,判断你个人实际能遇到哪些提示。

say.text: 那条 Tip: 行是什么意思?
say.note: 会查到这条提示并深入解释

say.text: 这个被提示的功能到底是怎么实现的?
say.note: 会读实际代码讲清机制

say.text: 我这边能看到哪些提示?
say.note: 会读你的设置,列出你能遇到的提示

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip (startup, working, or Tip: lines), Claude pulls the live tip list, reads the actual code, and explains that exact tip in depth in the language you asked in, citing the file paths it read.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see. It also reads your senpi settings to tell you which tips you personally can encounter.

say_en.text: What does that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Looks it up and explains it in depth

say_en.text: How does that tipped feature actually work?
say_en.note: Reads the code and explains the mechanism

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: Reads your settings and lists your tips
